Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing the application of the sunset act to the intermediate driver's license program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing the application of the sunset act tothe intermediate driver's license program; and repealing RCW 43.131.397and 43.131.398.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 43.131.397 (Intermediate driver's license programReview)and 2000 c 115 s 12; and RCW 43.131.398 (Intermediate driver's license programRepeal)and 2000 c 115 s 13.
